```{r}
library(TDA)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
lifetimes = function(Y){
  pts = sort(as.vector(Y))
  n = length(pts)
  
  lt = (pts - c(0, pts[1:(n-1)])) / 2
  lt[1] = Inf 
  return(sort(lt, decreasing = T))
}

max_lifetimes = function(Y) lifetimes(Y)[2]
max_lifetimes(c(0, 0.1, 0.4, 0.8))
```
```{r}
nsim = 100
sim = numeric(nsim)

for (i in 1:nsim){
  pts = generate_points_binom(100, 1)
  g = lifetimes(pts)
  m = sqrt(alphaComplexDiag(pts, printProgress = F)$diagram[, 3])
  sim[i] = all(g == m)
}
print(mean(sim))
```




# Binomial
```{r}
generate_points_binom = function(n, d) matrix(runif(d * n), nrow = n)


sim_maxlifetimes_binom = function(n, nsim, d = 1){
  output = numeric()
  for (i in 1:nsim){
    if (d == 1){ 
      sim = max_lifetimes(generate_points_binom(n, d))
      names(sim) = "dim = 0"
    }
    else sim = max_lifetimes_gudhi(generate_points_binom(n, d))
    output = rbind(output, sim)
  }
  rownames(output) = 1:nsim
  
  return(output)
}

```

```{r}
# tag formen af alle dimmension også af de specifik dimmensionelle huller især da dem af dim 1 ligner log(n)/n
n_seq = 3:1000
d = 1
nsim = 100
lmax_binom = numeric(length(n_seq))
names(lmax_binom) = n_seq
i = 1
for (n in n_seq){
  sim = sim_maxlifetimes_binom(n, nsim, d)
  lmax_binom[i] = mean(na.omit(sim))
  i = i + 1
}
plot(n_seq, lmax_binom, type = "l")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(n_seq, 1 / lmax_binom, type = "l")

M1 = lm(I(1 / lmax_binom) ~ n_seq - 1)
a = M1$coefficients 
plot(n_seq, lmax_binom, type = "l")
f = function(x) 1 /(a * x)
curve(f, add = T, col = "blue")


```
```{r}
M1 = lm(lmax_binom ~ I(log(n_seq)/n_seq) - 1)
a = M1$coefficients 
plot(n_seq, lmax_binom, type = "l")
f = function(x) a * log(x) / x
curve(f, add = T, col = "blue")
a
```

```{r}

for (i in 1:length(n_seq)){
  M = sim_maxlifetimes_binom(n_seq[i], nsim, 1)
```

# Poisson
```{r}
generate_points_pois = function(lambda, d){
  n = rpois(1, lambda)
  return(generate_points_binom(n, d))
}

library(spatstat)
plot(Fest(as.ppp(generate_points_pois(100, 2), W = owin())))
```
```{r}
sim_maxlifetimes_pois = function(lambda, r = Inf, nsim){
  output = numeric()
  for (i in 1:nsim){
    
    sim = lifetimes(generate_points_pois(lambda, 1))
    sim = sim[sim < r]
    if (length(sim) == 0) sim = NA
    else sim = max(sim)
    names(sim) = "dim = 0"
    output = rbind(output, sim)
  }
  rownames(output) = 1:nsim
  
  return(output)
}
sim_maxlifetimes_pois(5, 1/50, 5)
```

```{r}
#2-sparse
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
n_seq = c(2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100)
r_seq = n_seq^(-7 / 4)
nsim = 10000

for (i in 1:length(n_seq)){
  M = na.omit(sim_maxlifetimes_pois(n_seq[i], r_seq[i], nsim = nsim))
  print(qqweibull(min(r_seq[i],1/2) - M, main = paste("n =", n_seq[i])))
}
```

#plots using GAI
```{r}
n_seq = 3:1000
d = 1
nsim = 100
lmax_binom = numeric(length(n_seq))
names(lmax_binom) = n_seq
i = 1
for (n in n_seq){
  sim = sim_maxlifetimes_binom(n, nsim, d)
  lmax_binom[i] = mean(na.omit(sim))
  i = i + 1
}

M1 = lm(lmax_binom ~ I(log(n_seq)/n_seq) - 1)
a = M1$coefficients
```


```{r}


df = data.frame(n_seq = n_seq, lmax_binom = lmax_binom)

ggplot(df, aes(x = n_seq)) +
  # Raw data: Thicker line (linewidth = 1.2)
  geom_line(aes(y = lmax_binom, color = "Simulated maximum lifetime"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Fitted curve: Thinner line (linewidth = 0.6)
  geom_function(aes(color = "Fitted Model"), 
                fun = function(x) a * log(x) / x, 
                linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Manual color selection & Legend formatting
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL, # Legend name
    values = c("Simulated maximum lifetime" = "darkgreen", "Fitted Model" = "magenta")
  ) +
  
  # Labels and styling
  labs(
    title = "Maximum Lifetimes of the connected components 
    of a 1-dimensional homogeneous Binomial 
    spatial point process in [0,1] with n points",
    x = "n",
    y = "Maximum Lifetimes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),      # Places the legend in the top-right
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"), # Anchors the top-right corner of the legend box
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "lightgray") # Adds a clean background box  
)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
n_seq = c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200)
nsim = 10000
P_binom1 = list()

for (i in 1:length(n_seq)){
  M = sim_maxlifetimes_binom(n_seq[i], nsim, 1)
  P_binom1 = c(P_binom1,qqweibull_gg(1/2 - M, main = paste("n =",n_seq[i])))

}
```
```{r}
final_grid = wrap_plots(P_binom1[[1]], P_binom1[[2]], P_binom1[[3]], P_binom1[[4]], P_binom1[[5]], P_binom1[[6]], ncol = 3, nrow = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Weibull Q-Q plot of Maximum Lifetimes of the connected 
    components of a 1-dimensional homogeneous Binomial 
    spatial point process in [0,1] with n points",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  )
print(final_grid)
```
